## Summary

[Partial] Remove the driver side tail light assembly to identify the red wire for reverse control. [t915]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the driver side tail light assembly by undoing two bolts accessible with the rear door open and popping off snaps.
2. Identify the red wire in the cluster, which is typically the live wire feeding the middle reverse bulb.

_Procedure reported by [t915]._
